## Quality Gates

- [ ] Test count did not decrease
- [ ] Code quality agent reviewed (complexity, duplication, patterns)
- [ ] Test validator agent reviewed (coverage, assertions, TDD)

## Self-Review Checklist

- [ ] I read the diff and it matches the intent
- [ ] No debug code, console.logs, or TODOs left behind
- [ ] Error handling is appropriate (not swallowed)
- [ ] New code follows existing patterns in the codebase
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed
